tei:div.tei:p: 343) ༄༅/ kun mkhyen lha yi bla ma nyi ma'i gnyen// mgon des dag pa'i 'khor la gsungs pa'i chos// ḍāk+k-i 'bum gyi snying khrag dron mo de// yongs la ma grags 'phags pa'i blor ma shong*// che ba bdun dang tshul bzhis khyad par 'phags// thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod chen gcig pu ba// tshe lus gcig la sangs rgyas sar bgrod byed// yid shes bde myur skyob pa sngags kyi lam// thabs kyi khyad par 'phags pas bskal mang gis// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho yud la rdzogs par mdzod// dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med lta ba yin// snod bcud dag pa lha yi 'khor lo sgrubs// zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyis// sa lam mthon po'i yon tan mnga' dbang bsgyur// ta na ga ṇa'i spyod pa brlang po yis// rtogs goms mthar phyin gdul dka' thabs kyis bsgral// drang don blo sna mang pos sa chod med// sngags lam 'dir bsten nyi zla'i bgrod pa bzhin// de bas skye bar bla ma gtsug tu khur// rdo rje dril 'dzin dag mnyam lta pa rtogs// sbyor sgrol spyod pas don gnyis lhun gyis grub// sngags kyi lam dang nam yang 'bral med shog

dang*/ 344) thub bstan lung so thar rtogs chos kyi rgya mtsho la// blo gros byang sems dri ma med pa'i gzugs brgya 'char// 'od gsal gsang sngags klong chen yangs pa'i gzhi la 'khyil// mchog gi sprul sku bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ sdom pa gsum gyi mtshan gyi cod paṇa bcings pa dang chabs gcig dpal chen 'dus pas so// zhus so/
